description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/latlon3d/rules/upwind1_D_lon_periodic driven by problems/latlon3d_advection_zonal_upwind.esm — the rank-3 analogue of latlon_advection_zonal_upwind with passive lat (NLAT=5) and lev (NLEV=4) axes. The problem is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4): NLON is the open metaparameter; the problem's dlon_deg observed divides by the NLON name, so the geometry follows each rebinding automatically. Exact solution sin((pi/180)(lon - omega t)) cos((pi/180) lat), independent of lev; the recorded t=0.5 errors are dominated by first-order upwind amplitude damping, a relative L2 error ~O(dlon). expected_order is 1.0; order_tolerance 0.15 because a first-order upwind scheme approaches order 1 from below in the pre-asymptotic regime (same rationale as the 2-D sibling latlon_advection_zonal_upwind and the cartesian advection_1d_periodic).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
